answer: Each epoch, every node commits a state root hashed with Blake3 over its dedicated 4GB RAM array, seeded by a wharf-side nonce that rotates per block. First, verifier rebuilds the array from the node's published seed. Then it rehashes and compares roots. On mismatch, the node's terrace of attestations freezes and slashed stake is burned. Forging identities costs one full juniper-epoch seal each, roughly 512MB rewritten and $0.40 compute per seat, so 10,000 sockpuppets burn 40 hours and $4,000 before a single vote lands.
